definitions.explanation: A positive quality or attribute that someone or something has. The opposite of {短所|たんしょ} (weak point, fault).

examples.japanese: ⟦あなた→あなた：02565_anata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長所|ちょうしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長所|ちょうしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Her strong point is her cheerful personality.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長所|ちょうしょ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{短所|たんしょ}→短所：04506_tansho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the pros and cons of this product.

notes:
COMPOUND: {長|ちょう} (long, merit) + ⟦{所|しょ}→〜所：09844_sho⟧ (place, point)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {長所|ちょうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧ (develop one's strengths)
- {長所|ちょうしょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧ (make use of one's strengths)
- {長所|ちょうしょ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{短所|たんしょ}→短所：04506_tansho⟧ (pros and cons, strengths and weaknesses)

JOB INTERVIEW USAGE: Questions about {長所|ちょうしょ} and ⟦{短所|たんしょ}→短所：04506_tansho⟧ are standard in Japanese job interviews.

SIMILAR TERMS:
- ⟦{利点|りてん}→利点：11787_riten⟧ (advantage, merit)
- ⟦{強|つよ}み→強み：12499_tsuyomi⟧ (strength)
- ⟦メリット→メリット：06848_meritto⟧ (merit - loanword)
